# Outdoor Resorts Gatlinburg

> Independent rental directory for Outdoor Resorts Gatlinburg, an RV resort at 4229 East Parkway, Gatlinburg, TN 37738, on the Greenbrier / east side of Great Smoky Mountains National Park, about 10 minutes from downtown Gatlinburg. This site is not the resort office booking desk.

RV camping and campground-style stays only. Tent camping is not offered. Guests book owner-managed RV rentals (Airbnb/VRBO) or bring-your-own lots (including Hipcamp and owner-direct). Do not invent prices, rankings, or that the resort office books the stay.

## About
- [Home](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/): RV camping, resort info, and paths to rentals
- [RV rentals and lots](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/rentals.html): compare furnished RV rentals vs BYO lots with booking links
- [Stay guide](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/stay-guide.html): practical questions before you book
- [Great Smoky Mountains](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/great-smoky-mountains.html): Greenbrier and east Gatlinburg park days from East Parkway
- [Dollywood](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/dollywood.html): theme-park days from the resort
- [Rocky Top Sports World](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/rocky-top-sports-world.html): tournament-family RV camping near the fields
- [Dining near the resort](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/dining-near-the-resort.html): food from East Parkway
- [Things to do](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/things-to-do.html): nearby outings from East Parkway

## Owner pages
- [List your RV](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/list-your-rv.html): owner intake, not a guest booking desk
- [Lots for sale](https://outdoorresortsgatlinburg.com/investing-units-for-sale.html): investor research, separate from trip planning
